content.text:
The campaign is finished and submitted. My pick is **index 2 (Pb 0.74 / Sb 0.26)**, which had the highest efficiency (EQE) of the three compositions I measured: **0.0313%**. I don't know how that compares with the best composition in the library.

| Index | Pb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.85 | 0.0221 |
| 2 | 0.74 | **0.0313** |
| 14 | 0.50 | 0.00275 |

- **The 50:50 composition is about 10x worse.** That's the Pb₂Sb₂O₇ pyrochlore region, which likely absorbs weakly at 2.4 eV.
- **Pb-rich is better, but only up to a point.** Going further to 0.85 Pb lowered the EQE, so the peak is probably somewhere between 0.70 and 0.80 Pb. The untested neighbours (indices 1 and 3) could beat index 2.
- **The Sb-rich end (indices 20–29) was never measured.** I skipped it because more Sb was lowering the EQE and the PbSb₂O₆ phase there is expected to absorb poorly at 2.4 eV. That's an inference, not a measurement.

I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are actually present was never checked.
